revision_reason: P2 uses 2 GiB available on both host and WSL; the measured candidate peak RSS was about 386 MiB and reference generation needs about 384 MiB. This retains roughly fourfold memory headroom while preserving the host CPU gate.
correctness_rule: Every element must be finite and satisfy abs_error <= abs_tol + rel_tol * abs(reference); time, checksums and error summaries must also be finite.

measurement.failure_policy: Any failed measured run makes the configuration evaluation invalid; do not score a successful subset.
measurement.repeat_escalation_rule: Frozen at five measured runs from P1 pilot CV 0.011 and relative MAD 0.009; post-hoc escalation is not used in this session.
measurement.timeout_rule_after_p1: For each optimization level use max(60 seconds, ceil(3 * the largest measured default-size P1 pilot process wall time for that level)); O3 includes its repeatability runs.
measurement.cost_accounting: Record core compute time separately from build, reference generation, validation and total process wall time.

cache_policy.performance_cache_use: Forbidden for formal samples. Resume only complete configuration groups from this session's original raw samples.
